hints.title: Selective In-Place Inversion
hints.text: Invert alphabetical characters from both outer ends while leaving non-letter symbols fixed in place.

hints.title: Non-Letter Skipping
hints.text: Advance the left index when looking at a non-letter, and retract the right index when looking at a non-letter.

hints.title: Letter Swapping Action
hints.text: When both pointers indicate alphabetic characters, swap them and advance both pointers toward the center.
